guardrails: Do not merge to main until required checks pass and the change set is reviewed.
Reuse working features; do not rebuild from scratch without evidence.
Before removing any route/file, inspect imports, links, redirects, API callbacks, auth, tests, and deployment dependencies.
Never delete customer data, database tables, migrations, or APIs as incidental sitemap cleanup.
Preserve server-side authorization, Supabase RLS, secure cookies, private storage, rate limits, and fail-closed behavior.
Do not invent product inventory, prices, subscription benefits, client names, or case-study claims.
Keep custom service packages separate from platform/product subscription tiers.
Update both project context files and README after each meaningful implementation change.
Follow docs/LINETECH-SITEMAP.md V2. Public XML and Worker allowlist match; all assets pass through Worker first. Never claim inactive company/commerce modules are live.
